objectives.statement: Choose quantity words by whether the noun is countable or uncountable.
Use litt and lite to express a small amount with positive or negative tone.
Distinguish all, alt, alle, and hele in common noun phrases.
Use begge and både ... og for two people or things.

notes: Merged quantity lesson. Must preserve coverage from quantifiers, mange/mye, litt/lite, all/alt/alle, and begge/både where appropriate. Include countable vs uncountable, noen/noe, all/alt/alle vs hele, both både ... og and begge, and the positive/negative tone contrast between litt and lite.
